title: Outlook Went Down? Microsoft May Owe You Money
summary: If your Microsoft business services were offline last week, you’re probably entitled to a partial credit on your next monthly bill.
llm_summary: If Microsoft’s business services—including Outlook—were down last week, many users may qualify for a partial credit on their next bill. The outage triggered Microsoft’s service‑level agreement provisions, which require compensation when downtime exceeds the guaranteed availability thresholds. Affected customers should check their account portals for the credit details.
